def document_analyser(doc):
    inside = False
    was_letter = False
    max_len = 0
    cur_len = 0
    word_count = 0
    for ch in doc:
        if ch == '(':
            inside = True
            was_letter = False
            cur_len = 0
        elif ch == ')':
            inside = False
            was_letter = False
            cur_len = 0
        elif ch.isalpha():
            if inside and not was_letter:
                word_count += 1
            elif not inside:
                cur_len += 1
                if cur_len > max_len:
                    max_len = cur_len
            was_letter = True
        else:
            was_letter = False
            cur_len = 0
    return [max_len, word_count]

def main():
    import sys
    line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    tokens = line.split()
    n = int(tokens[0])
    s = tokens[1]
    res = document_analyser(s)
    print(res[0], res[1])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
